**Title:** [Phase 3] Select and recruit 5-20 pilot homes (voluntary participants)

**Labels:** phase-3, pilot, community

**Body:**

We need real (or realistic) pilot participants.

Tasks:
- Define clear criteria for pilot homes (owner-occupied, willing to participate in governance, etc.)
- Create outreach materials / one-pager based on the whitepaper
- Build a simple intake form (Google Form or self-hosted)
- Document the selection process and consent / participation agreement
- Aim for diversity across a few geographies if possible

**References:**
- `launch/roadmap.md` Phase 3
- `docs/Sophia_Whitepaper.md`
- Presidential Packet goals

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Pilot criteria document
- At least draft outreach materials committed
- First 3-5 interested participants logged (even if not yet onboarded)

**Milestone:** Phase 3 - Pilot Launch
